data.narrative:
Sarla Aviation is a Series A-stage drone and autonomous systems company founded by Rakesh Gaonkar and Adrian Schmidt, having raised $13M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a comp universe of 8 private firms in the Drones & Autonomous sector, including Waymo, Wayve, Zipline, Joby Aviation, and Nuro. No public comparables exist in this narrowly defined category.

A peer-median approach proved inapplicable due to insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables meeting minimum sample thresholds (fewer than 3 datapoints after filtering). Consequently, the analysis relies on stage-progression methodology, which applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A progression to the $13M capital raised proxy, yielding an implied valuation of $26M. This single-method triangulation supports a valuation range of $22M to $30M, with a median of $26M.

Key uncertainties center on the small private comp set available for cross-validation and the absence of public market pricing signals in autonomous systems. The stage-progression approach is mechanistic and does not incorporate company-specific metrics such as revenue run-rate, unit economics, or technology differentiation. A more robust valuation would require either identification of additional same-stage private comparables or the emergence of public market comps in the autonomous vehicle space to calibrate multiples empirically.
